result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position: it limits inspections to once per 12 months, retains 30 days’ written notice (better than the 15-day fallback), confines inspection to business hours, and keeps all inspection costs with HDI (better than the fallback allocation). Adding only the frequency cap is sufficient and preserves the existing scope and commercial intent. It does not reach the preferred position because it does not require an independent, confidentiality-bound auditor or expressly prohibit direct system access. Drafting is clear, though the commas around “may” are awkward.
